source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/screens/01-dashboard.png (artboard image is the authority per SETUP); dc.html id="p1"; README screen 1
notes: Region-composition check, not a value check (page-frame.json and the per-part specs already check exact colours/type/spacing). This spec checks that the artboard's regions exist, in the artboard's top-to-bottom order, inside `[data-audit="dashboard"]` — the real DashboardBrief mounted by page-frame-1440.

The masthead (VOL line, title, dek, command bar) is NOT inside this mount (page-frame-1440 wraps DashboardBrief only, no DashboardMasthead) — verified separately by source read of src/app/page.tsx + src/components/dashboard/DashboardMasthead.tsx and the live-server screenshot docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/built/uxfix-5.1-4.1-4.2-5.2-2.1-2.2-dashboard.png. A follow-up mount that adds DashboardMasthead (stubbing useAuth/useWorkspaceStore/useWorkspaceBootstrap) would let this spec check the masthead region too.

Artboard order top to bottom: band tiles (Immediate/Action/Monitor/Awareness) -> Due next card (heading, column header, rows, foot 'All N immediate' / 'then N action . N monitor') -> What changed card (heading, column header, rows, foot) -> rail (Across the platform, Watchlist, Legend), rail running alongside the two left-column cards, not below them.
Due-next foot's 'All N immediate' is a real link to /regulations?band=immediate per operator ruling 1.1 (closed) — checked below as an <a>/Link element, not plain text.

UI FIX ROUND 2026-09-08, items A1/A3 (lane cardrule): the rows named 'A1 rule on ...' and 'A3 shell of ...' below measure the card shell the operator ruled belongs to the CARD component. They assert the gradient's exact value, which the earlier rule rows on this page did not; the closing 'CLASS CLOSURE' row is the check that fails if any card on this page renders with no rule at all.

ITEM F2 (operator, 2026-09-08): "'Due next' and 'What changed' must use the same row component as the lists (B), including 56px rows and the overflow cell." They already do on this base — DashboardBrief.tsx imports ListRow/ListRowColumnHeader and renders no row markup of its own — so nothing was rebuilt; the rows below MEASURE it on the real dashboard tree so the claim is evidence rather than a source read, and so a future page-local table would fail here.

Lane duenext (2026-09-08): regions 2b and 3b assert a NON-ZERO row count in each of the two cards. Every spec here was a composition check, so a card whose read supplies nothing still passed every region assertion while rendering an empty state, which is exactly what shipped.

children.name: BRIEFDATA: the Due next card renders rows against the populated fixture, never zero
children.note: Operator ruling 2026-09-08, verbatim: "do next and whats changed need to stay populated." The production state was DUE NEXT with 0 ITEMS. A card that can render zero rows against a fixture that HAS matching data is the defect; against this fixture, which carries both the 50-row payload and the by-id backfill the route now merges (mounts.mjs's PAGE_FRAME_FIXTURES.dashboard), zero rows can only mean the selection or the merge broke.

children.name: BRIEFDATA: the What changed card renders rows against the populated fixture, never zero
children.note: Same ruling, other card. The fixture's change feed deliberately names an item OUTSIDE the 50-row payload (c0) — the live ratio measured 2026-09-08 was 6 of 6 — so this row also proves the backfill is what fills the card, not a coincidental overlap.

children.name: region 2b, Due next renders a NON-ZERO row count against the populated fixture (lane duenext, production defect 2026-09-08)
children.note: THE PROOF THAT BITES. On production this card read "0 ITEMS" while the corpus held 45 future-dated items, because the read feeding it (get_workspace_intelligence_dashboard) is ordered by PRIORITY with LIMIT 50 and that slice contained no future date at all. Every existing spec here checked that the card's REGIONS exist; none checked that it renders any ROWS, so the whole class was invisible to the audit. The fixture carries two resources with a future complianceDeadline (2027-01-01 and 2026-12-30), so two rows is the correct count, and any drop to zero (a starved read, a broken dueInfo, a lost complianceDeadline mapping) fails here.

children.name: region 3b, What changed renders a NON-ZERO row count against the populated fixture (lane duenext)
children.note: Same class as 2b for the other card. The fixture carries one recentChanges entry, so one row. On production this card rendered "no detection pass on record" with an empty feed while get_workspace_recent_changes returned 500 rows against the live DB: the payload was the empty fallback, and no spec asked whether the card had rows.

forbid.name: no floating Ask AI button (ruling 2.2)
forbid.reason: The masthead command bar's 'Ask' is the only ask surface sitewide; a second floating control is a dead-region violation per ruling 2.2.

forbid.name: row impact meter never renders bare '0' for an unscored item (ruling: never 0)
forbid.reason: An unscored row's impact cell must render ImpactMeter's dashed baseline + Absence reason, never a fabricated zero score. The regex form is deliberate: a plain "0/12" substring also matches the legitimate "10/12", which made this forbid report a passing product as a defect.

forbid.name: D-M4: no list row carries more than one absence token
forbid.reason: D-M4 (operator mobile report 2026-09-08) [CONFIRMED at 1440 and at 390]. The impact, due and tier cells each rendered their own <Absence>, so a row missing all three drew a dashed baseline plus UNSCORED plus PENDING plus NOT IN PRIMARY SOURCE — three tokens, the third on a line of its own. Ruling 2.1 allows exactly ONE reason per row. This selector matches a row carrying a token in TWO of the three cells, which is the defect and nothing else. The structural guarantee is ListRow's `reasonSlot`.

forbid.name: CLASS CLOSURE (dashboard): a card element that renders no 3px rule
forbid.reason: Coordinator note N3: 'Prove the class is closed ... a check that fails when a card element renders without it'. Encoded as a FORBID, which is the harness's own form for 'the design does not have this element': every card in the product is `SectionCard` (src/components/ui/SectionCard.tsx), which stamps `data-section-card` on itself and mounts the 3px rule in one of exactly two positions (its first flow child, or inside its own absolutely positioned wrapper when the card carries padding). This selector reaches a card with the rule in NEITHER position, so a match is a ruleless card and the row goes NOT IN SPEC. Ruling 5.2's band-grouping card, the one card that legitimately draws no dark-grey rule, stamps `data-section-card="band-grouping"` instead, so it is outside this selector by identity rather than by being invisible to it.

forbid.name: BRIEFDATA: no What-changed row renders the Absence token in its tier cell
forbid.reason: The photographed defect, pinned at its narrowest point. The fixture's change feed names an item OUTSIDE the LIMIT-50 payload (c0) — the live ratio measured 2026-09-08 was 6 of 6 — and its row must still resolve to a real tier chip, because the corpus the card selects from now includes the bounded by-id backfill (src/app/page.tsx, mounts.mjs's PAGE_FRAME_FIXTURES.dashboard.briefResources). Before this lane the same cell rendered NOT IN PRIMARY SOURCE on every change row. A match here means the backfill stopped reaching the card and the degrade path is the whole card again.
